messages:
nina: RFC follow-up: propose capability-peel for long-term modularization. Start by extracting prefix-cache and session-router behind a tiny socket-based API. Three stages: shim, read-only redirect, full handoff. Thoughts?

alex: +1. Two immediate concerns: latency overhead and contract creep. Recommend loopback shim for perf and a strict contract lint.

harry: Ops checklist: co-locate on node with unix socket for hotpaths, fallback to in-process, add circuit-breaker and fast kill-switch. Canary by tenant cohort only.

sre-bot: infra: created ticket PROV-789 to provision socket namespaces and canary cluster.

security: Sidecar security: require ephemeral tenant tokens, least-privileged KMS mapping, and audit logs for cross-process accesses. Will draft ACL mapping.

nina: Success criteria proposal: p50 +<=8ms, p99 +<=25ms, no >5% unit-cost regression after batching. Also require token-level cost traces.

alex: I'll draft a minimal contract for get_many with max_staleness and served_from markers. Keep it intentionally small.

harry: Plan: 3-day spike (shim + bench), 2-week read-only canary, 2-week write canary. Rollback runbook ready.

nina: Action items: alex -> contract + shim; harry -> ops playbook + canary; security -> ACL doc. Kick spike next Monday unless objections.

alex: Will post shim perf numbers within 48h.
